question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Tight
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tight"** means firmly held or fastened; difficult to move or undo. (कसकर)

 
 
• **Example: **The lid on the jar was so tight that I couldn't open it.
 
 
 
• **"Slack" **refers to something that is loose or not taut; not held tightly in position. (ढीला)
 
 
• **Example: **The rope was **slack**, causing the tent to collapse.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'tight' **is **'slack'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cordial **(मित्रतापूर्ण): Warm and friendly.

 
 
• **Example:** They had a** cordial** meeting where both parties agreed to work together.
 
 
 
• **Comfortable **(आरामदायक): Providing physical ease and relaxation.
 
 
• **Example: **The new sofa is very **comfortable** to sit on.
 
 
 
• **Resilient** (लचीला): Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the hardships, she remained **resilient** and optimistic.
